omission_boundary: The eight binary stdout originals remain complete local run files. They are not copied into this light capsule. Seven are byte-identical to the named pinned compressed Git blobs. The archive batch stdout is explicitly distinguished from the 490564596-byte archive and is represented by the ordered 409 durable payload blobs plus documented Git batch framing. No MCP capture is synthesized.

omitted_original_binary_stdout.stdout_framing: For each listed blob: ASCII git_blob_sha + space + blob + space + decimal bytes + LF, exact blob bytes, then LF. No bytes follow the last LF.

scope: Exact existing execution envelopes, unchanged new retrieval source/tests and their actual test output, original verifier execution/stdout/stderr, 29 actual Git command records with stdin/stderr and small stdout, and independent retriever-review source records. No production command or Lean is rerun while creating this capsule. All original files remain unchanged.
